text:
Maya (mktg): Quick check — for Wed's 'Inference at Scale' demo: finalizing Zoom config + post-event routing. Need auto captions, cloud recording, separate clips for benchmark snippets, and an enterprise follow-up path. @Jorge @Taylor can you confirm?
Jorge (events): Checklist incoming. Plan: cloud recording (full + clips), enable auto-transcript, set Taylor as alternative host, disable participant local recordings, enable 'record separate audio files'. Retention set to 90 days. Recommend passcode OFF (reg page is the gate).
Taylor (producer): I'll be host. On recording: set to "Record active speaker with shared screen" + gallery for panel extraction. We'll capture a second stream for slides. I'll also start a manual local backup just in case.
Priya (demandgen): Nurture plan: immediate replay email + 3 segmentation paths — Dev trial CTA, Benchmarks whitepaper, Enterprise consult. Tag new leads with `webinar_inference_2026`. Zapier -> HubSpot should add property `webinar_track: inference` and `utm_campaign`.
Sam (sales): Sales ops ask: anyone who watches >50% or clicks 'schedule enterprise' should be flagged MQL and auto-assigned to AE queue "Enterprise-PLG". Also add boolean `requested_benchmark=true` if they click benchmark CTA.
Maya (mktg): Quick Zap snippet for HubSpot push (Priya can finalize):
```json
POST /hooks/zapier/hubspot
{
  "email": "{{registrant.email}}",
  "tags": ["webinar_inference_2026"],
  "webinar_track": "inference",
  "utm_campaign": "inference-demo-march"
}
```
Jorge (events): I'll enable live captions + auto-transcript. Taylor, can you toggle cloud recording to create two assets (full and trimmed) and mark clip timestamps in the live doc? We'll need timecodes to make 30-90s benchmark clips.
Taylor (producer): Yep — I'll drop timestamps into the shared doc during the session. After recording I'll run a quick pass: trim clips, export SRT, and upload to GCS/publish links to the assets folder.
ZoomBot: Cloud recording started by Taylor at 1971234700 :movie_camera:
Maya (mktg): Post-event TODOs — assign tasks:
• Taylor: trim + upload clips + SRT
• Priya: build nurture flows + replay email copy
• Sam: review attendees marked MQL and follow up
• Jorge: export Zoom attendance/reporting + handoff infra logs
Please add Asana tasks and tag owners. Also set replay email to go out 30 minutes after recording processed (:hourglass_flowing_sand:).
Priya (demandgen): Also request translation for captions (EN, FR, DE). Can we auto-generate via transcripts and send to vendor? If yes, I'll add budget line.
Sam (sales): Fine. For enterprise leads, add CRM property `event_engagement: high/med/low` based on watch % and CTA clicks.
Maya (mktg): Great. I'll draft replay email and share for review. If anyone sees gaps (lead routing or clip requirements), flag now. :thumbsup:
